I reviewed the diff against `SUPERBOSS_DISPATCH_PROMPT.md`'s tiered trust model and audit standards. This is additive tooling (audit pipeline scripts + configs), touches no `.github/workflows/**`, no schema/migration/auth paths — tier1 classification checks out.

**Verdict: approve.** No injection, secrets, or destructive-action risks; subprocess calls are list-form, DB writes are parameterized, and the shared write-lock/schema convention matches sibling phases. Flagged (non-blocking) issues: the RLS-presence regex check doesn't strip SQL comments (possible false negatives on missing-RLS findings), an unused `shutil` import in the documentation pipeline, `prisma validate` invoked via bare `npx` instead of the repo-local binary (inconsistent with the eslint pipeline's approach), and three files from the diffstat (`.sqlfluff`, the phase plan YAML, the ESLint ruleset `.mjs`) weren't visible in the diff text I was given, so I couldn't directly inspect their contents.

Written to `review-verdict.json` in the workspace root as requested.
